input.quote: 21.3 Under no circumstances shall any Party be liable to any other Party in contract, tort, (including negligence or breach of statutory duty) or otherwise for loss (whether direct or indirect) of profits, property, traffic, business or anticipated savings, or for any indirect or consequential loss or damage in connection with the operation of this Agreement howsoever caused.
input.rationale: Paragraph 21.3 is a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential loss (and of loss of profits, traffic, business and anticipated savings), which is helpful and symmetric. However, there is no aggregate monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement: a full-text search returns no "aggregate liability" or "shall not exceed" language, and the only other liability provisions are the PG members' non-liability at 4.9, the mutual third-party indemnity at 21.2 (limited to each Party's Schedule B share) and the claim-sharing provisions at 32.5/32.6. Each Party's direct liability to the others therefore remains unlimited, which fails the fallback requirement of a mutual cap plus carve-outs. Because this is a consortium cost-sharing agreement rather than a fee-based supply contract, we have expressed the cap base as amounts paid or payable by the liable Party under the Agreement in the preceding twelve months, subject to a US$1,000,000 floor, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud carved out. The cap is drafted mutually so it does not disadvantage us relative to the other APCN 2 Parties.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap (greater of 12 months' contributions and US$1,000,000) with carve-outs, alongside the existing consequential loss waiver.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 21 waives indirect loss but leaves each Party's direct liability entirely uncapped, so we have added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' contributions under this Agreement and US$1,000,000. Indemnification obligations under Subparagraph 21.2, confidentiality breaches and gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud sit outside the cap; a straight twelve-month cap would be an acceptable fallback.

ops.text: 21.4 Except in respect of Excluded Claims, the total aggregate liability of each Party to the other Parties arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by that Party under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) one million US dollars (US$1,000,000). For the purposes of this Subparagraph 21.4, "Excluded Claims" means a Party's indemnification obligations under Subparagraph 21.2, a Party's breach of Paragraph 31 (Confidentiality), and a Party's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud.
